objects.name: Analytic 2240
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies malformed, oversized, or out-of-spec ICS protocol messages sent to an embedded field device from an unexpected or unauthorized source. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: NSM:Content
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: malformed or oversized Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol message from unexpected source followed by device behavioral anomaly (reboot, mode change) within a short window
